N-add04b#2.zh: 哈哈！想打这儿过，把买路财留下啦！
N-add04b#2.t: Ha ha! If you want to pass this way, leave your toll money behind!

N-add04b#3.zh: 岂有此理！向来都是俺打劫人家，今日你们这几个毛贼竟敢太岁爷头上动土！
N-add04b#3.t: Outrageous! I'm the one who does the robbing, and today you petty thieves dare to pull the tiger's whiskers!

N-add04b#4.zh: 朱武道：「都是绿林中人，何必赶尽杀绝。把头领打得服软了，我们三个过去劝他入伙。」
N-add04b#4.t: Zhu Wu said: "We're all of the greenwood. Why fight to the death? Beat their chief until he gives in, and the three of us will go over and talk him into joining us."

N-add04b#6.zh: 胜利条件   --- 收服或打败所有敌人（头领体力不到一半后，朱武、陈达或杨春走到他身边劝降，头领带身边最多四个手下归顺）
N-add04b#6.t: Victory --- Win over or defeat all enemies (once a chief is below half HP, Zhu Wu, Chen Da or Yang Chun can walk up and talk him round; he surrenders with up to four of his nearest men)

N-add04b#8.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！
N-add04b#8.t: The turn limit has run out with the mission unfinished. Game over!

N-add04b#9.zh: %N死亡，众人不敌盗贼围攻，荒野平添几缕英魂........
N-add04b#9.t: %N died, and the others could not hold off the bandits. A few more heroic ghosts now haunt the wilderness........

N-add04b#10.zh: 果然好身手，一会儿就把贼人打跑了！
N-add04b#10.t: What skill! The bandits were beaten off in no time!

N-add04b#11.zh: 可恶……这几个人好生了得！

N-add04b#12.zh: 这个头领伤得不轻，朱武、陈达或杨春走到他身边，可以劝他带身边几个弟兄入伙（最多四个）。
N-add04b#12.t: Their chief is badly hurt. If Zhu Wu, Chen Da or Yang Chun walks up to him, they can talk him into joining with a few of his men (up to four).

N-add04b#13.zh: 在下朱武，少华山的头领。大家都是绿林中人，何必自相残杀？不如带了弟兄跟我们走！
N-add04b#13.t: I am Zhu Wu, a chief of Mount Shaohua. We're all of the greenwood. Why kill each other? Bring your brothers and come with us!

N-add04b#14.zh: 原来是少华山的好汉！小人有眼不识泰山，情愿带弟兄们追随！
N-add04b#14.t: So you're the heroes of Mount Shaohua! Forgive me for not knowing Mount Tai when I saw it. I'll gladly follow you with my brothers!

N-add04b#15.zh: 俺是跳涧虎陈达！你这身手不坏，跟着俺们干，强似在这山径上剪径！
N-add04b#15.t: I'm "Gorge-Leaping Tiger" Chen Da! You're not bad. Come with us. It beats robbing travellers on this mountain path!

N-add04b#17.zh: 在下白花蛇杨春。同是落草之人，兄弟若肯入伙，从此有福同享！
N-add04b#17.t: I am "White-Patterned Snake" Yang Chun. We're both outlaws. If you'll join us, brother, from now on we share our fortune!
